thread:
alix: Heads-up: MerchantCo pilot kickoff tomorrow 11am PT. We need a quick pre-call pack: POC success criteria, eval harness goldens, and answers to their security/KMS questions. Add anything critical by 4pm.

marta: For success criteria I want 3 user journeys: happy path, recovery from partial data, and hallucination containment. Suggest golden set = 25 canonical examples + 5 targeted edge cases. Performance target request from their infra: sustained 200 reqs/min and p95 < 700ms.

samir: For the harness, let's do JSONL goldens with expected outputs and scoring keys. Also capture failure-mode tags per example (e.g., missing-entity, contradicts-known-fact). We should also export tokens-used per run.

priya: Security note: MerchantCo asks whether keys can be customer-managed for hosted tenants or only for Private. I believe hosted supports external KMS via our HSM integration but not per-tenant CMKs today. Tagging infra/solutions.

carl-sales: Pricing question from them: if they need spikes above trial capacity, what are the options? I will draft a short note: 1) short-term burst (3 weeks) add-on, 2) immediate dedicated reservation conversion with prorated commit. Need a ballpark for a 3-week burst to show them.

marta: Scoring suggestion: composite = 0.5*exactness + 0.35*factuality + 0.15*safety. Each example gets a 0-1 float. Gate = mean >= 0.82 and zero items marked as critical-failure. Borderline examples (within 0.05 of gate) go to manual review.

samir: Example golden JSONL entry I propose:
```jsonl
{"id":"G-001","prompt":"Extract the refund reason and propose next step","expected":"refund_reason: <short>; action: <one-line>","weights":"{\"exactness\":0.5,\"factuality\":0.35,\"safety\":0.15}","failure_tags":["missing-entity"]}
```

priya: Security-bot, please run a quick parse on their questionnaire and flag anything outside our standard pilot scope.

security-bot: Questionnaire received (merchantco_sq.pdf). Auto-scan results: requests for 5-year log retention, per-tenant CMK, and encrypted backups. Flag: per-tenant CMK for hosted = not supported by default.

priya: OK noted. For log retention we can confirm 1 year on Hosted; Dedicated customers can extend retention via config or archive exports. I'll follow up with infra to confirm backup encryption specifics.

carl-sales: On the 3-week burst example: propose simple illustration: 2x trial throughput for 3 weeks => temporary burst fee = estimated $12k (placeholder) + option to convert to committed Dedicated at month boundary. I'll put a sample line in a one-pager.

alix: Ops timeline: by 4pm today finalize goldens + rubric; tonight run baseline against two variants; present consolidated pilot plan tomorrow before the call. Sound feasible?

marta: I'll finish the goldens and include expected outputs and human-review notes by 3pm.

samir: I'll run baseline on redwood-13b and redwood-13b-int8, capture p50/p95, throughput, and token counts.

priya: Also need legal to confirm pilot data usage clause. Adding a short note to legal.

samir: Quick eval config snippet (for the harness runner):
```yaml
eval_name: merchant_pilot_v0
models: [redwood-13b, redwood-13b-int8]
concurrency: 8
batching: {max_batch_size: 12, max_tokens: 1024}
metrics: [throughput_rps, latency_p95, composite_score, critical_fail_count]
```

alix: Great. Action items: Marta = goldens + human-review markers, Samir = baseline runs + perf metrics, Priya = complete security answers + KMS confirmation, Carl = pricing note for burst + commit path. I'll assemble the pre-call deck at 5pm and post to drive.

carl-sales: Added draft pricing snippet -> https://drive.company/merchant-pricing-draft (placeholder).

marta: Uploaded goldens -> https://drive.company/merchant-goldens-v2 (placeholder).

priya: No blockers from security besides the CMK limitation; legal will weigh in on data usage but won't block pilot.

alix: Thanks all. If anything else crops up ping me directly. See you on the kickoff. :rocket:
